training.global_attention_mask: ModernBERT native alternating local/global attention; no explicit global mask
training.supplementary_checkpoint: minimum validation loss, earliest epoch on exact tie
training.head: CLS -> Linear(768,768) -> tanh -> Linear(768,1) -> sigmoid; new pooler (ModernBERT has no native pretrained pooler)

assumptions_not_disclosed_by_authors: training margin m=0.1 and tolerance n=0.01 (retained from the already predeclared earlier experiment, not fitted to this test)
no scheduler, warmup or gradient clipping
validation seed42 and ceil rounding to 105 rows
FP32 and activation checkpointing for V100 memory
dynamic padding and 4096 cap to preserve all original text
Longformer control omitted explicit global mask based on public inference code; ModernBERT uses its native alternating attention
final epoch primary and validation-loss-selected checkpoint supplementary
Previously fixed Longformer control loaded base pretrained Longformer including its pooler and author default Linear initialization; ModernBERT initialization is specified separately below
ModernBERT native tokenizer and pretrained encoder replace Longformer; ModernBERT new pooler has BERT-style normal(0,.02) weights and zero bias; fc retains author default Linear initialization
Longformer retained its pretrained pooler; this comparison evaluates the practical encoder replacement and cannot isolate pure architecture effects
ModernBERT requires Transformers>=4.48; use tested 4.50.3 SDK and require old Longformer checkpoint replay <=1e-6 with exactly identical fixed-threshold classes

evaluation.primary_comparison: seed42 final epoch10 ModernBERT minus fixed Longformer seed42 final epoch10
evaluation.supplement: each validation loss minimum, earliest exact tie

bootstrap.method: paired resample of 20 reference groups; recompute global metrics with all rows of each drawn group; percentile 95% intervals; separate per-seed comparisons

evaluation.interpretation: original public split content overlap retained, not unseen-reference generalization

runtime.software_choice_basis: ModernBERT official API support; pinned existing V100-tested image; Longformer replay compatibility gate

baseline_experiment.role: fixed previously completed paired-seed Longformer control; never select by test closeness
